title: Take the weight and lower the engine/transmission assembly out

notices.text: Take the full weight on the cradle BEFORE undoing the engine and transmission mounts. Then lower in small increments while a second person watches every remaining cable, hose and harness for tension — something is always still attached. An experienced shop quotes 4-6 hours for the drop; budget 6 for a careful first time. Do not attempt this alone, and do not let the assembly hang on one support point.

steps.text: Take the weight and lower the engine/transmission assembly out.

fasteners.name: Engine mount to carrier, upper bolts

tools.name: drivetrain drop table or two transmission jacks
